Automation Settings

Control how auto-replies work across the system

Auto Reply

Globally enable or disable AI-powered auto replies for all contacts

Enable Auto Reply

AI is paused — no replies will be sent

Paused

Auto reply is disabled. Incoming messages will not receive AI responses, even if individual contacts have AI enabled.

Default Bot

The fallback bot used when a contact has no specific bot assigned

Default Bot

Contacts without a specific bot assignment will use this bot

None — AI won't reply without a bot assigned

No default bot set. Contacts without a specific bot assigned will not receive AI replies.
